description: After your claim binds the surface, publish the JSON files the packet's definition of done probes — e.g. its /.well-known/… path. Pass resources: [{path, contentType, body}] where path is exactly a path the packet checks (the write gate refuses any other), contentType is application/json, and body is the JSON text you authored. Atomic: readers see the old set or the new set, never half. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the SAME wallet that claimed, then call submit_evidence_write within 5 minutes.

resources.description: 1-8 files: {path: "/.well-known/…", contentType: "application/json", body: "<json text>"}. Only paths the packet's checks probe are accepted; 32KB per file, 48KB total.

name: prepare_evidence_write
title: Publish the packet's files to your evidence surface — free (step 1 of 2)
